svg.desc: GoodEWorkers, openness. Recursive partition in flat colour, after Book of 100 plates B012, B011, B019, B092. Structure: frame and composition cuts; process: recursive bisection at 0.3-0.7; mark: one rule per cut, 4 / 3.5 / 3 / 2.5 / 2 by depth, flat fills. Parameters: window cut at 0.16 / 0.6 / 0.7 of the frame, top edge unruled; sides and sill bisected to depth 7, min 34, stop 0.2. Seed: rng("openness-4"), book-core.js.
